SPECIFICATION & FORMULA

Calculation Methodology

Gross Required = (Target Net + Overhead) / (1 - Tax%). Billable Hours/Year = Billable Hours/Week × 48 Working Weeks. Minimum Hourly Rate = Gross Required / Billable Hours/Year. The deduction rate is assumed to apply to gross billings, not taxable profit after deductible expenses. Zero billable hours and deductions of 100% or more are infeasible.

REFERENCE BASIS: Standard Industry Financial & Technical Formula • ASSUMPTIONS MODEL: 2026-10-27

Reference Notes & FAQ

Why can't freelancers divide annual salary by 2,080 hours?

Full-time freelancers typically spend 30%–40% of their week on unbilled tasks (proposals, invoicing, revisions) and take holidays, leaving ~1,100–1,250 true billable hours per year.
